newsitem.title: USA: Applied Power sees record FY97 net, sales.
newsitem.headline: Applied Power sees record FY97 net, sales.

text.p: Applied Power Inc said Wednesday that it expects to report record sales and earnings in fiscal 1997, with earnings likely in a range of $2.70 to $3.00 a share and sales of $650 million to $690 million.

"We feel we can continue the record sales and earnings performance," Richard Sim, chairman, said in a statement. "Including the effect of the recent Everest acquisition, we think Applied Power is positioned to deliver sales of $650 to $690 million, and earnings per share of $2.70 to $3.00 for the year."
Applied Power completed the acquisition of Everest Electronic Equipment in late September. It bought Everest, which makes custom and standard electronic enclosures, for about $52 million.
Earlier, the company reported record earnings for fiscal 1996 ended August 31 of $2.41 a share, up from last year's $1.82 a share, excluding a charge.
The company said its sales of its Wright Line business grew 37 percent in fiscal 1996, and Distributed Products' sales increased more than seven percent.

Engineered Solutions' sales fell one percent from last year, primarily the result of the softening in the convertible top market in the United States and Europe and the sale of its APITECH Mobile Equipment business in January, 1996.
Geographically, sales grew in all regions except Latin America.

Outstanding debt at August 31 rose to $92.6 million from $87.0 million at the beginning of the year due to acquisitions. The debt to capital ratio declined, reflecting strong earnings this year, to 34 percent at August 31 from 37 percent at the beginning of the year, it said.
